question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word:

 Pulchritude
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Pulchritude"** refers to physical beauty or attractiveness. (सुंदरता)
 
 
• **Example:** Her pulchritude was admired by everyone at the party.
 
 
• **"Plainness"** is the antonym of pulchritude and means lack of physical beauty or simplicity. (सादगी)
 
 
• **Example:** The plainness of the room made it feel dull and unappealing.
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of "Pulchritude"
